threshold: validation balanced accuracy; same search as baseline
xgb_grid: same predefined three configurations as original
road_data: Geofabrik OSM regional/country extracts, frozen hashes and timestamps
matching: local OSRM if available; explicit coverage and match confidence, not observed route truth
missing_policy: retain all journeys; missing graph features as NaN plus matching-quality variables
comparison: full common val/test population with original models; additionally report matching coverage
time_features: model-based durations on fixed road snapshot, never observed historical times

feature_parameters_before_graph_results.complete_rule: one subtrace, >=90% points matched, confidence >=0.5; no filtering
feature_parameters_before_graph_results.proximity_graph: directed OSM nodes, static access, no turn restrictions
feature_parameters_before_graph_results.overlap: unique directed edges, weighted by length
